page.layout: Two columns of dictionary entries on one page: left column, then right column. Running heads at the top left and top right. Page number at the top left. A Hebrew letter pair at the bottom right.

main_text.p: צַמְרָת ramus summus[?], צַמְרָתוֹ ejus, No. f. fæm. aff. Rad. צמר; vel pro צַמֶּרֶת, Rad. צמר præcidit.
צַמֵּית sitities[?], Ruth. 2. 9. (pro צַמִּית, qu. à צָמָה atque id pro צַמְּאַת,) præt. Kal, 2. s. f. Rad. צָמָא sitivit.
צָמַתִּי jejunasti, צְמַתֶּם jejunastis, צַמְּתִּנִי jejunastis mihi, præt. Kal, 2. s. m. & 2. pl. m. vel f. aff. Rad. צום.
צָמְתָה exscidit, צְמַתּוּנִי, & gem. צְמַתְּתוּנִי exscindunt me, Psal. 88. 17. צְמַתְּתַנִּי succidit me, præt. Piel, 3. s. m. & 3. pl. aff. ut & 3. s. f. (צְמַתָּה,) aff. Rad. צָמַת exscidit.
צָמְתִּי sitio, Jud. 4. 19. (pro צַמְּאתִי,) præt. Kal, 1. s. Rad. צָמָא.
צָמְתְּךָ crines tui, sing. fæm. aff. No. צָמָה co-
צְנָה clypeus, scutum, No. sing. fæm. Rad. צנן.
צֹנָה oves, greges, Psal. 8. 8. pro צַאנָה, atque id transp. pro No. Rad. צאן oves, grex, unde etiam צְנַאכֶם gregibus vestris, Num. 32. 24. pro transp. צַאנְכֶם, ab eod. No. Rad. צאן grex.
צְנוּרֶיךָ canales tui, pl. m. aff. No. צְנוֹר, Rad. inusit. צנר.
בִּצְנָה in aculeis, pl. f. No. צְנָה ctypeus, R. צנן.
צְנִים צְנִידִים aculei, spinæ, No. pl. masc. Rad. צנן.
צְנוּמוֹת graciles, pl. f. No. צְנוּמָה ; Rad. inusit. צנם.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate; consonants were read from the scan. Doubtful Latin: "summus" (printed form looks like "fuminus"), "sitities" (Ruth 2. 9 gloss), "co-" / "ma" continue across the column break. The Hebrew pair at the bottom right (צע) is a printed footer letter pair, not a catchword, and has been left out. The printed forms "ctypeus" and "inusit." are reproduced as printed. Several Hebrew forms in the Num. 32. 24 and "graciles" entries are partly overprinted and may be wrong.
